subject: Consolidating IAM licenses + device posture pilot — pricing and next steps
messages:
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com>
To: Jordan Ellis <jordan.ellis@okta.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sun, 11 Apr 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Consolidating IAM licenses + device posture pilot — pricing and next steps

Hi Jordan,

Hope you had a good weekend. We're starting a Q2 review of identity spend and want to explore consolidating several Okta SKUs across product, infra, and platform teams. Two asks to start:  

1) Can you share an updated quote that consolidates our existing Workforce SSO seats, an MFA-only tier for contractors (~220 seats), and a separate pool for service accounts (approx 80)? We're evaluating a 12–24 month committed term — include both one-year and two-year pricing.

2) We want to run a short device posture pilot (macOS + iOS, ~350 devices) to validate posture signals and conditional access rules before broad rollout. What does an add-on pilot SOW look like and can you outline the timeline and pricing for a 6-week engagement?

I've attached our current seat inventory and a sample of device telemetry to help size the pilot.

Next steps from our side: Monica will confirm final seat counts by Wed; Karthik will scope the technical test plan. Please let me know if you need a quick call this week.

Thanks,

Rishi Malhotra
Head of Platform Operations
Redwood Inference

Attachments: current-okta-seat-inventory.csv (CSV stub), fleet-posture-sample.xlsx (Excel stub)

---

From: Jordan Ellis <jordan.ellis@okta.com>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Matthew Price <matthew.price@okta.com>
Date: Mon, 12 Apr 2027 10:40:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Consolidating IAM licenses + device posture pilot — pricing and next steps

Hi Rishi — thanks for the clear ask and the attachments. Happy to help. Quick responses inline:  

1) Consolidated pricing: we can produce a blended quote that moves your contractor group to an MFA-only SKU and folds service accounts into a discounted bulk pool. I can provide 12- and 24-month committed pricing; ballpark: ~18% discount for two-year commit vs. pay-as-you-go. I'll attach an official estimate by EOD Tue.

2) Device posture pilot: we typically run a 4–6 week pilot. Deliverables: config for posture signals, conditional access policy templates, evaluation dashboard, and a short runbook for ops. Estimated professional services: $25k–$35k depending on integration complexity. We can fast-track a pilot SOW and start with a kickoff within two weeks of the SOW sign-off.

To scope properly, can you confirm: (a) whether you plan to use Okta Verify or third-party MDM signals for posture; (b) which CIAM services you have in production (SAML/OIDC clients we need to test against).

Happy to set a 30-min call — are you available Wed 3pm PT?

Best,
Jordan Ellis
Enterprise AE, Okta

---

From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com>, Jordan Ellis <jordan.ellis@okta.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 14 Apr 2027 08:23:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Consolidating IAM licenses + device posture pilot — pricing and next steps

Thanks Jordan — quick notes from finance/procurement planning:  

- Contractor seats (~220): these must be MFA-only and billed monthly. We may consolidate them under a single org billing profile but need MFA enforcement without directory SSO licenses.
- Service accounts (~80): these are primarily CI/CD and monitoring service principals — we prefer a token-based pool with non-interactive licensing.
- Seat counts above are provisional; I expect to finalize by end of day Thu (2027-04-15).

Also, to reduce procurement friction, can Okta include a standard Net-30 invoice option on the 12-month quote and clarify renewal notice windows? Procurement will flag any auto-renew terms longer than 30 days notice.

Monica Patel
Director, Finance Operations
Redwood Inference

---

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>
To: Jordan Ellis <jordan.ellis@okta.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, 16 Apr 2027 11:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Consolidating IAM licenses + device posture pilot — pricing and next steps

Jordan — technical clarifications:  

- We'll use Jamf for macOS posture signals and Intune for the small Windows fleet; primary posture signals will be MDM compliance + disk encryption + FW state. We do use Okta Verify in pockets but prefer relying on MDM for the pilot to reduce onboarding scope.
- CIAM endpoints: we have a mix of SAML (legacy dashboards) and OIDC (new services). We'll provide a prioritized test list.
- Network topology: a few apps sit in a private VPC and will require split DNS adjustments during the pilot; estimate 2–3 infra changes.

If you can prepare a draft SOW that reflects MDM-based signals and a list of pre-kickoff dependencies, we'll review and hand back redlines.

Thanks,
Karthik Iyer
Senior Security Engineer
Redwood Inference

---

From: Jordan Ellis <jordan.ellis@okta.com>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Matthew Price <matthew.price@okta.com>, procurement@secureops.com
Date: Thu, 22 Apr 2027 14:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Consolidating IAM licenses + device posture pilot — pricing and next steps

Team — attaching the estimate and an initial SOW draft. Highlights:  

- Quote attached: includes 12- and 24-month committed pricing with MFA-only SKU for 220 contractor seats and a bulk service-account pool for 80 non-interactive identities. Net-30 is available on the 12-month option.
- Pilot SOW: 5-week engagement, MDM-sourced posture signals, conditional access templates, evaluation dashboards, and a 90-day optional follow-up health check. Professional services estimate: $28k.

Please review the SOW and the seat assumptions. If the counts change, the estimate will be updated. Once you provide final counts, I can issue a formal quote and DocuSign for signature.

Jordan Ellis
Enterprise AE, Okta

Attachments: rdw-okta-estimate-2027Q2.pdf (PDF stub), rdw-okta-sow-draft.docx (Word stub)
